Thanks for starting the onboarding; attached is our completed vendor bank form and W-9. If you must use ACH, we can accept domestic ACH via the correspondent (see note below).

Bank details (primary):
- Account name: FieldBridge Inc.
- Account number: 987654321
- Bank: GlobalTrust Bank (US Correspondent)
- ABA (for USD wires/ACH): 021000021

Intermediary bank (for international wires):
- Intermediary: MetroBank International
- SWIFT: METRUS33
- Intermediary ABA (if routed through US): 026009593

Remittance guidance (please include this exact string in the payment reference):
- REMIT: RBW-PO#{PO_NUMBER} | INV#{INVOICE_NUMBER} | FIELDBRIDGE
Example: REMIT: RBW-PO#12345 | INV#2027-021 | FIELDBRIDGE

Attachments: vendor_bank_form.pdf (completed), W-9 (tax form). Also happy to provide a voided check upon request.

Let me know if you need the intermediary bank's routing details in another format or a notarized bank letter.

Best,
Samantha Torres
Head of Finance Operations
FieldBridge Inc.

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: FieldBridge bank details & remittance instructions

Samantha —

Thanks for the details and the completed form. Quick clarifications before we create the payee record:
1) Can you confirm the account type (checking vs. savings)?
2) Please confirm FieldBridge's TIN/EIN for our supplier record (we need this to complete the banking profile).
3) For the intermediary bank: can you provide the exact beneficiary / beneficiary address that should appear on the wire instruction? Some correspondent chains require an "attn:" line.
4) We will map your invoices to Redwood PO tags. To avoid remittance mismatches can you confirm you will include the exact REMIT string in the wire instructions (we can't reliably parse free-text).

If you can also attach a voided check or bank letter, that will speed verification. Marissa — looping you for the finance onboarding steps and DOC signing permission. Laura — please advise if we should request a notarized bank letter for this vendor.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Sr. Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
